method.check.bad: {another} = « (you can choose another one)» or empty.
method.source.pick: Line above the source table when there are several methods; {select} = drop-down menu (HTML).
method.error: Error in the method window; {message} = technical text.
method.row.ms2n: «MS2» row of the parameters table; {n} = number of scans, {per} = per cycle.
method.name: Name of a method inside a .dam file that contains more than one (one per sample); {n} = number.
method.m.title: Title of the section of an Agilent method folder (.m) in the Method window; {name} = folder name.
method.m.windows: Line under the compounds table of a .m method: method windows; {ref} = reference RT window, {non} = of the others, {unit} = unit (%), {corr} = correlation window.
method.doc.fields: Title of the collapsible box with all the fields of the file, in the Method window; {n} = how many.
method.doc.btn.xic.tip: Title and aria-label of the «XIC» button of an inclusion-list row in the Method window; {mz} = m/z of the entry.
method.doc.btn.ms2.tip: Title and aria-label of the «MS2» button of an inclusion-list row, when an MS² scan matches; {mz} = precursor m/z, {rt} = RT of the scan in minutes.
method.m.error: Error reading a .m method in the Method window; {name} = folder, {message} = reason.
method.reg.go: Accessible name of the button of an error-log entry in the method window: moves the cursor to its time; {t} = time in minutes.
method.doc.notes: Title of the list, at the top of the method section in the Method window, of the method/1.warnings entries (parts not decoded, missing, truncated).
method.file.damaged.experiment_header: Line under Tandem-MS parameters by segment in the Method window: the header of experiment {experiment} of the method is damaged and was not read.
method.file.damaged.mass_range: Line under Tandem-MS parameters by segment in the Method window: the mass range of experiment {experiment} of the method is damaged and was not read.
method.file.val.eV: Cell of the tandem-MS segment table in the Method window: an energy in electronvolts; {v} = number.
method.file.val.V: Cell of the tandem-MS segment table in the Method window: a voltage in volts; {v} = number.
method.file.val.ms: Cell of the tandem-MS segment table in the Method window: a time in milliseconds; {v} = number.
method.file.product: Precursor and product m/z of an MRM transition in the segment table of the Method window; {q1} = precursor, {q3} = product.
method.file.range: Scanned m/z range in the segment table of the Method window; {lo} = low, {hi} = high.
method.file.msLevel: MS level in the scan column of the segment table of the Method window; {n} = level.
method.file.sep: Separator between the scan type, MS level and name in one cell of the segment table of the Method window.
method.lc.holdTip: Tooltip of the dashed part of the gradient and of its last table row; {b} = % B, {from}, {to} = times in min (two decimals).
method.src.read: Tooltip of a value read from the file; {at} = the stream and field it was read from (technical, as the file names it).
method.src.inferred: Tooltip of a value computed from values read from the file; {at} = how it is computed.
method.val.min: A time with its unit in the Method window; {v} = the number (two decimals).
method.val.C: A temperature with its unit in the Method window; {v} = the number (two decimals).
method.val.unit: A value with its unit in the diode-array rows; {v} = the number or range, {unit} = nm, min, Hz or °C.
